typeinfo.note: THE RECORD IS NOT IN THIS CLASS'S OWN OVERLAY. _ZTI/_ZTS have vague linkage and mwld kept the single copy in ov025, while the vtable stayed in ov091. Proved from the cartridge, not inferred: the two ABI preamble words below _ZTV11daDsnBase_c read 0x00000000 (offset-to-top) and 0x021137f8 (RTTI pointer), and config/arm9/overlays/ov025/symbols.txt:121 is what names that address.

vtable.note: the symbol IS the address point; the two ABI preamble words (offset-to-top 0x0, RTTI pointer 0x021137f8) sit at -8 and -4. 0x88 = 8 preamble bytes + 32 slots x 4, and tubuild verify reports the emitted section at exactly 0x88, so rtti_vtables.py's known extent over-report does NOT apply to this class.
vtable.slot_count_evidence: read word-by-word out of extracted/dsd/arm9_overlays/ov091.bin at file offset 0x42fc (module base 0x02130f00). Same count as the base dBgActor_c -- daDsnBase_c adds no slot, it only overrides.

base_evidence: _ZTI11daDsnBase_c is a __si_class_type_info with ONE base at subobject offset 0, whose +8 word points at _ZTI10dBgActor_c (ov002 0x021089ec). Corroborated by length: _ZTV10dBgActor_c and _ZTV11daDsnBase_c are both 32 slots, and slot 31 of this table still holds dBgActor_c::Kill (0x020ee55c). Full ancestor chain, 5 levels: daDsnBase_c -> dBgActor_c -> dActor_c -> dBase_c -> fBase_c.
abstract_evidence: slots 0 and 6 hold a bare 0x00000000 in the cartridge and no relocation in config/arm9/overlays/ov091/relocs.txt reaches either word -- which is how a pure virtual reads once the linker is done. Each leaf (daDsn_c, daDkk_c) supplies both for real.

overrides.name: InitResources
overrides.note: PURE. Null word in the ROM, supplied by each leaf.

overrides.name: CleanupResources
overrides.note: THE KEY FUNCTION -- the first declared virtual that is neither inline nor pure, so the TU that defines it emits _ZTV11daDsnBase_c and both destructor variants. The ROM spelled this symbol _ZN6Thwomp16CleanupResourcesEv, but slot 3 of THIS class's vtable holds it and Thwomp's table merely inherits the word, so it belongs to daDsnBase_c.

overrides.name: Behavior
overrides.note: PURE. Null word in the ROM, supplied by each leaf.

overrides.name: Render
overrides.note: Same crossed-name story as slot 3: the ROM spelled it _ZN6Thwomp6RenderEv, but it is this class's slot word and Thwomp inherits it.

overrides.name: ~daDsnBase_c (D1)
overrides.note: body defined INLINE in include/daDsnBase_c.h so that both descendants inline it; this out-of-line copy exists only because the vtable is emitted here. Empty but not inert -- it tears down mShadowModel (+0x338) then mTextureSequence (+0x324) in reverse declaration order, then the dBgActor_c base step.

overrides.name: ~daDsnBase_c (D0, deleting)
overrides.note: SITS BELOW D1 IN THE CARTRIDGE. That order is not reproducible by any admissible source form -- see unproven/blockers below and the manifest's boundary_evidence.

inherited_unchanged_slots: slots 1, 2, 4, 5, 7, 8, 10-15 and 18-30 still hold dActor_c's own words (all point into arm9); slot 31 holds dBgActor_c::Kill at ov002 0x020ee55c. This class adds no slot and overrides exactly four (3, 9, 16, 17) beyond the two it leaves pure (0, 6).

non_virtual.note: Finds the closest actor with ID 9 and, if it is within this actor's clip radius, enables the mesh collider. Calls dActor_c::OnAimedAtWithEgg (slot 29) through the vtable.
State step: counts down the 0x39e delay byte, then sets state 0x398 = 0 and reloads the delay to 0x28.
State step: on delay expiry sets state 4 and reloads a random delay of 0x14..0x1d.
The fall step. Accelerates 0xa8 downward, clamps Y to 0x394, then on landing either HugeLandingDust (actor type 0xa1) or particle 0x2e, plus an Earthquake and sound 0xc7.
State step: on delay expiry sets state 2.
The rise step. Adds 0xa000 to Y, clamps to the rest height 0x390, then sets state 1 and a random delay of 0xa..0x27.
Drop-shadow sizing. Scales the shadow by the fall distance (Y minus 0x394), copies the model matrix 0xf0 -> 0x360, and calls dActor_c::DropShadowScaleXYZ with mShadowModel (+0x338).

text_span_note: 11 functions, one contiguous linker run, from build/tu_map.json. Boundary confidence medium on both sides.
size_evidence: MINIMAL READING, and said as such. mShadowModel closes at 0x338 + 0x28 = 0x360 and nothing this class owns reaches higher. The two leaves allocate MORE and disagree with each other -- daDkk_c_classInit passes 928 = 0x3a0 and Thwomp_Spawn 932 = 0x3a4 -- so no allocation literal fixes this class's end. 0x360..0x3a0 exists in both leaves and is declared on them.

fields.name: mFileTable
fields.note: a void** in practice. CleanupResources releases entries [0], [1] and, when non-null, [3]; Render reads entry [3] to decide whether to run the texture animation. NAME IS COINED.

fields.name: mTextureSequence
fields.note: Two-sided evidence: Thwomp_Spawn and daDkk_c_classInit both call _ZN15TextureSequenceC1Ev at +0x324 while the vptr is this class's, and this class's own D1 calls its D1 there.

fields.name: mShadowModel
fields.note: Same two-sided evidence, _ZN11ShadowModelC1Ev at +0x338. Corroborated a third way: func_ov091_02133098 passes this+0x338 as dActor_c::DropShadowScaleXYZ's ShadowModel& parameter.

pad: 0x360..0x3a0 is NOT declared here -- it exists in both leaves and is declared on them, because the two leaves' allocation sizes disagree and neither pins this class's end.
unproven: the field NAMES: nothing in the ROM names them, all three are coined from what the code does
the original English names of the seven func_ov091_* members -- they are unnamed in the ROM config and no mangled spelling survives
the exact meaning of the state machine's 0x398 state ids (0..4) and the 0x39e delay byte's name
whether 0x360..0x3a0 belongs to this class: the two leaves allocate 0x3a0 and 0x3a4 and disagree, so it stays declared on the leaves
the return types of CleanupResources and Render are taken as s32 from the header; both bodies only ever return the literal 1, so a bool spelling is not excluded by the bytes
blockers: THE DESTRUCTOR PAIR IS NOT PROMOTABLE INTO THE LICENSED RUN. The cartridge puts D0 (0x02132d04) BELOW D1 (0x02132d6c). mwccarm 2004/b56's lever set for destructor variant order is closed: inline in the class body emits D1 then D0, always; out of line emits D2, D0, D1 and adds a homeless D2 the ROM does not carry. Both variants BYTE-MATCH from the inline form, so the source form is right and only the ORDER is unreproducible. Handled as a 9-of-11 partial promotion; the two shards stay enrolled and the TU's own copies are licensed deadstrip-duplicate.

Nothing outside the vtable depends on those two addresses: the only references to either in all of config/ are relocs.txt 0x0213523c -> 0x02132d6c and 0x02135240 -> 0x02132d04, which are vtable slots 16 and 17. No instruction in the image calls either address.
